clue.text: Commercials about conflict medals

indicators.note: about means the first piece goes round the other, enclosing it

parts.note: commercials are adverts, ADS for short
a conflict is a war

explanation.surface: Advertisers cash in on the honours handed out after a war.
explanation.definitionFit: Awards are prizes or decorations, and medals are the commonest such honours given out.

clue.text: A meeting place in the street

parts.note: a venue is a place where people meet

explanation.surface: An open-air rendezvous in the road.
explanation.definitionFit: An avenue is a broad road in a town, a kind of street.

clue.text: A quiet boy eats one special hors d'oeuvre

parts.note: P, piano, is the musical direction for quiet

indicators.note: eats means the boy's name takes the next letters inside it

parts.note: Peter is a boy's name
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A silent lad tucks into a particular starter.
explanation.definitionFit: An appetiser is a small dish served before a meal, the same as an hors d'oeuvre.

clue.text: Assuming fellow has new gin cocktail

parts.note: a don is a fellow of a university college

indicators.note: a cocktail is a mixture, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: A college fellow takes a new gin drink for granted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Assuming' reads as supposing, but here it means putting on, as one assumes a hat.
explanation.definitionFit: Donning clothes is putting them on, as in assuming a garment or role.

clue.text: Chap with sex appeal and no degree somewhere in Canada

parts.note: a chap is a man
IT is old slang for sex appeal, as in the 'It girl'
O looks like zero, so stands for no or nothing
BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a university degree

explanation.surface: An attractive man without a university degree lives somewhere in Canada.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and' simply joins the pieces; 'no' gives O and 'degree' gives BA, rather than 'no degree' meaning a missing qualification.
explanation.definitionFit: Manitoba is a province of central Canada, so it is indeed somewhere in that country.

clue.text: Choir ceased singing in the prelate's see

indicators.note: a choir singing makes its notes move around, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A choir stops singing in the bishop's district.
explanation.definitionFit: An archdiocese is the district under an archbishop, a prelate's see.

clue.text: Sets one married model sells initially

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
to pose is to model, as for a painter

indicators.note: initially asks for the opening letter of the word it follows

explanation.surface: A married model sets up a sale of her clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: To impose a rule or tax is to set it on people.

clue.text: Nothing green apparent

parts.note: O looks like zero, so means nothing
vert is the heraldic word for green

explanation.surface: A lack of greenery is plain to see.
explanation.walkthrough: VERT is the colour green in heraldry.
explanation.definitionFit: Overt means open and not concealed, so plainly apparent.

clue.text: Criminal's offspring is going into painting

indicators.note: going into means these pieces are placed inside the other

parts.note: painting is art
a son is offspring

explanation.surface: A felon's child takes up painting.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of 'Criminal's' is a link meaning 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: An arsonist deliberately sets fires, which is a criminal act, making them a criminal.

clue.text: Grow former plant and next derivative initially

parts.note: EX is a prefix or word meaning former, as in an ex-partner

indicators.note: initially tells us to take the opening letter of each of the four words before it

explanation.surface: A botanist describes the spread of an old plant and its offshoots.
explanation.definitionFit: To expand is to increase in size, which is what growing means.

clue.text: Looting of purses PC foils

indicators.note: looting suggests things ransacked and turned over, so these letters are thrown into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A police constable stops thieves raiding handbags.
explanation.walkthrough: 'foils' looks like a noun at the end of a sentence, but it is the verb: the officer thwarts the thieves.
explanation.definitionFit: To scupper a plan is to wreck or thwart it, the same as to foil it.

clue.text: Pristine fountain Teddington unveiled

indicators.note: unveiled says letters inside the following words are revealed once their outer letters are stripped away

explanation.surface: A clean fountain in Teddington, a London suburb, is ceremonially unveiled.
explanation.walkthrough: Teddington is a suburb of south-west London on the Thames.
explanation.definitionFit: Something untainted is unspoilt and uncontaminated, which is what pristine means.

clue.text: Zeroes countering XXX entertainment, US style?

definitions.text: Zeroes countering XXX entertainment, US style?

parts.words: Zeroes countering XXX entertainment, US style?
parts.note: a game in which noughts play against crosses, under its American name, though XXX suggests something racier

explanation.walkthrough: XXX hints at adult films, but here the Xs are the crosses of noughts and crosses, which Americans call by another name.
explanation.definitionFit: The American name for noughts and crosses, a pencil game of Os against Xs on a three-by-three grid.

clue.text: Demonstrated material?

definitions.meaning: to sit in is to stage a protest by occupying a place, so a sit-in protester demonstrated
a smooth glossy fabric used for dresses and linings

explanation.walkthrough: Split as SAT IN, the first sense is the past of 'sit in', a form of protest.
explanation.definitionFit: Read as two words it is the past of staging a sit-in; read whole it is a shiny woven fabric.

clue.text: Can Oasis guess about wiseness?

indicators.note: about here means moved around, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the three words taken as written

explanation.surface: A question whether the rock band Oasis could guess something about wisdom.
explanation.walkthrough: Oasis was a British rock band of the 1990s.
explanation.definitionFit: Sagaciousness is the quality of being shrewd and wise, a synonym for wiseness.

clue.text: Therefore no microphone is biotechnological

parts.note: ergo is Latin for therefore
mic is short for microphone

explanation.surface: Lacking a microphone, a lab is thus advanced in its science.
explanation.definitionFit: Ergonomics is also called biotechnology, the study of people's efficiency in their working environment.

clue.text: Caused anger having closed after bad start

indicators.note: after places the second piece behind the first

parts.note: off means bad, as food goes off, and the off is the start of a race
ended means finished or closed

explanation.surface: A shop shut after a poor opening and annoyed its customers.
explanation.definitionFit: If you offended someone you caused them annoyance or anger.

clue.text: A small-sounding assembly

parts.note: a meeting whose name seems to say it holds only a handful, since its start is pronounced like a low number

explanation.walkthrough: The opening FORE sounds like 'four', so the word seems to describe a gathering of just four people.
explanation.definitionFit: Foregathering is a dated word for coming together in a meeting or assembly.

clue.text: The rug I unravelled for Oklahoma city folk singer

indicators.note: unravelled means untangled, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A rug falls apart for a country musician from the Midwest.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition has two senses: Guthrie is a city in Oklahoma, and Woody Guthrie, born in Oklahoma, was a famous folk singer.
explanation.definitionFit: Guthrie is both a city in Oklahoma and the surname of the folk singer Woody Guthrie from that state.

clue.text: Queuing to take in clubs list

indicators.note: to take in means the first piece holds the second inside it

parts.note: people queuing stand in line
C is the abbreviation for clubs in card games

explanation.surface: Waiting to get into nightclubs on a guest list.
explanation.walkthrough: 'list' looks like a noun but is the verb meaning to lean, as a ship lists.
explanation.definitionFit: To incline is to lean or slope, which is what a ship does when it lists.

clue.text: Relax in the drawing room

definitions.meaning: to loll about lazily or sprawl at ease
a sitting room where guests are received

explanation.definitionFit: To lounge is to relax lazily, and a lounge is also a sitting or drawing room.

clue.text: Golem met a little insect

indicators.note: a little says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A clay monster of legend encounters a small bug.
explanation.walkthrough: A golem is a clay figure brought to life in Jewish folklore.
explanation.definitionFit: Emmet is an old and dialect word for an ant, which is an insect.

clue.text: Instant tea and fine coffee

parts.note: a mo, short for moment, is an instant
cha, or char, is slang for tea

explanation.surface: Instant tea and good coffee are on the menu.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Instant' looks like instant coffee, but it means a moment.
explanation.definitionFit: Mocha is a high-quality coffee named after the Yemeni port it was shipped from.

clue.text: High point of belief surrounding most of picture

indicators.note: surrounding means the first piece goes round the second

parts.note: a credo is a statement of belief

indicators.note: most of means the last letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: a scene is a picture or view

explanation.surface: Faith reaches its peak around an image.
explanation.definitionFit: A crescendo is the loudest or most intense moment, a climax or high point.

clue.text: Spruce up last month's lecture

parts.note: December is the last month of the year, DEC for short
to orate is to speak at length, as when lecturing

explanation.surface: Tidying things after a December talk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'last month's' sounds like the previous month, but means the final month of the year.
explanation.definitionFit: To spruce up a room is to smarten it, which is what decorating does.

clue.text: Fliers remain sky-high

indicators.note: sky-high suggests the letters are blown up and scattered, so they land in a new order

explanation.surface: Pilots stay up in the clouds.
explanation.definitionFit: Airmen are aviators, people who fly aircraft, so they are fliers.

clue.text: Debate is involving disease

indicators.note: involving here means twisted or entangled, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A medical condition is the subject of a public debate.
explanation.definitionFit: Diabetes is a disease in which the body cannot properly control blood sugar.

clue.text: Take heart from padre's cueing recovery

indicators.note: take heart from asks for letters drawn from inside the following words

explanation.surface: A priest's prompting gives encouragement during a person's convalescence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Take heart from' looks like 'be encouraged by'; it tells us to take the inner letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A rescue is a saving or retrieval, as in the recovery of a stranded climber.
